clauses.clause: **No single follower is slower than the group.** While the group moves, every follower's median speed ≥ 0.95× the group median (tune); time the player stands waiting for one follower > 10 m behind ≤ 10 % of escort time (tune). PO: "let me stay with the crowd for suvivor."
clauses.note: Fresh current-main native L7 high complete seed2: departure follower66 has27 qualified walking samples, median4.3485318979m/s versus group4.5812160184m/s, ratio0.9492090922 (<0.95). This is a small strict numeric miss (0.0791 percentage points), not evidence of large visible babysitting. The majority-of-three diagnostic passes the follower, but does not meet the unchanged every-follower criterion for this valid seed. L1 stationary-far fractions16.4561%/16.4696% are upper bounds and are explicitly rejected as causal waiting FAIL evidence. Repro: npm run qa:accept -- --level L7 --skip-browser; inspect G-13 high/complete, step/departure follower66 seed2.
